run_flux_control_training: run the flux-control training script to fine-tune a Flux model with control conditioning images
parse_training_arguments: parse command-line arguments for flux-control training including dataset, resolution, batch size, and optimizer settings
log_validation_images: log validation images generated by the trained flux-control transformer during training
encode_images_to_latents: encode input images and conditioning images through the VAE into latent space representations
save_model_card: generate a model card README with example validation images and license information for the trained model
